data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1969 experienced a gross prior year strengthening of $26.8 million in 2021. This adverse development was primarily driven by adverse incurred claims development on prior accident years, particularly in the Non-Marine Liability class, including large losses in Construction and Binders sub-classes, and the impact of social inflation. The overall calendar year result was also affected by catastrophe losses exceeding budget.
